title: Number of Applicants for SGUnited Mid-Career Pathways Programme
what_it_is: Number of Applicants for SGUnited Mid-Career Pathways Programme

sections.label: SGUP attachments and outcomes
sections.summary: SGUP company attachments, launched July 2020, placed over 7,200 mid-career jobseekers, with allowances around $2,600 and about 77% of 3,400 exiters employed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Speaker, company attachments under the SGUnited Mid-Career Pathways Programme (SGUP) were introduced in July 2020 amidst a weak labour market to provide mid-career jobseekers with opportunities to acquire work experiences, skills and networks while preparing for more permanent jobs in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: From the launch of the programme till January this year, over 7,200 mid-career local jobseekers have been placed into attachments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Trainees typically receive a monthly training allowance of between $1,600 and $3,800.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The average and median training allowances of SGUP participants are both around $2,600.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: As of November 2021, over 3,400 trainees have completed or exited their attachments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Amongst this group, about 2,600, or about 77%, were employed.

sections.label: SGUP applications by locals
sections.summary: As of January 2022, over 20,800 locals had applied for SGUP positions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: As of January 2022, over 20,800 locals have applied for SGUP positions.

sections.label: SGUP retained for mature trainees
sections.summary: SGUP will be retained as a permanent employment facilitation programme, available only for mature trainees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: As announced recently at Budget and MOM’s Committee of Supply, we will retain SGUP as one of our permanent employment facilitation programmes, but they are only available for mature trainees.
